title: Growth conjecture for MSTD subsets of dicyclic groups
statement:
Let $m\geq 2$ be an integer. For each $n\geq 3$, let $\mathrm{Dic}_{4n}$ be the dicyclic group of order $4n$, and let $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{Dic}_{4n}}(m)$ denote the number of MSTD subsets of size $m$. **Growth conjecture.** There exists a positive integer $K_m$ such that, whenever $n\geq K_m$,

$$
\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{Dic}_{4n}}(m)>2^{m/2}.
$$

The conjecture is proposed alongside an asymptotic comparison of MSTD and MDTS counts, following the paper's exact enumeration for small subset sizes; no resolution is supplied.
source_name: Sagar Mandal and Neetu, “Exact and Asymptotic Counts of MSTD, MDTS, and Balanced Sets in Dicyclic Groups”, arXiv:2602.09073 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09073

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2026).
